data.desc: Fold Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: FLD) is a financial services company built on a simple premise: consumers should be able to save, spend, and earn rewards in both U.S. dollars ('USD') and bitcoin through a single platform. Fold's consumer offerings include an FDIC-insured checking account, a Visa debit card (the 'Fold Debit Card'), a Visa credit card (the 'Fold Credit Card'), bill payment services, a bitcoin gift card, and an extensive catalog of merchant reward offers. The Company also offers various forms of bitcoin buying and selling with low-to-zero fees and insured custody. By integrating both dollars and bitcoin within familiar financial products, the Company aims to give consumers a single, practical platform for managing their everyday finances. The Company's products and services are available in the United States through the Fold mobile application (the 'Fold App').
